02_split_po_globex_a.pdf.note: Partial invoice; leaves a balance on PO-1002

03b_split_po_globex_overflow.pdf.label: Split PO — overflow
03b_split_po_globex_overflow.pdf.note: Third invoice against an exhausted PO. Run 2 and 3 first

04_missing_invoice_number.pdf.label: Missing invoice number
04_missing_invoice_number.pdf.note: Amounts are fine, but there is no audit key

05_scanned_no_text.pdf.label: Scanned, no text layer
05_scanned_no_text.pdf.note: Image-only PDF. Without an API key the process refuses to fabricate fields; with one, the vision route reads it.

06_duplicate_of_01.pdf.label: Duplicate submission
06_duplicate_of_01.pdf.note: Resubmission of INV-2201. Run the happy path first

07_multi_po_wayne.pdf.label: Covers two POs
07_multi_po_wayne.pdf.note: $6,500 against PO-1006 + PO-1007, which together authorise exactly that. Every dollar is approved, but the invoice never says which PO each line belongs to, so the split is calculated and held for a person to confirm.

08_fx_match_oscorp.pdf.label: Currency converts to a match
08_fx_match_oscorp.pdf.note: EUR 2,000.00 converts to USD 2,160.00 at the pinned exchange rate, which is exactly what PO-1008 authorises. A genuinely different currency, genuinely the same value once converted.

09_currency_number_collision_lexcorp.pdf.label: Same number, wrong currency
09_currency_number_collision_lexcorp.pdf.note: States 5,000.00 EUR against a 5,000.00 USD PO -- the identical digits, not a converted equivalent. No correct conversion produces that, so it's rejected as a currency-code error rather than held for review.

10_prompt_injection_cyberdyne.pdf.label: Instructions hidden in the invoice
10_prompt_injection_cyberdyne.pdf.note: An otherwise flawless invoice: approved vendor, open PO, exact amount, sound arithmetic. It carries text addressed to the extraction system -- a line item asking to auto-approve, and a footer claiming a system override. The text is transcribed verbatim and no instruction is acted on; the document is then rejected outright rather than queued, because one that tries to direct the process judging it is not trustworthy input. The cost of that policy is recorded beside the branch in rules.decide: the guard is a keyword matcher, so a genuine invoice tripping it needs an administrator to override.

11_line_item_mismatch_acme_tech.pdf.label: Same total, different line items
11_line_item_mismatch_acme_tech.pdf.note: INR 500,000 against PO-EDGE-001, which authorises exactly INR 500,000 -- so the PO matches, the balance covers it and the variance is zero. Underneath the total the order changed: the PO bought 10 laptops at 50,000, the invoice bills 8 at 62,500. A total-only comparison cannot see this, which is why the line-item rule exists. Held, not rejected: a short delivery at a revised price is a conversation, not fraud.

12_concurrency_race_keyboard_a.pdf.label: Concurrency race — 1 of 2
12_concurrency_race_keyboard_a.pdf.note: $4,000 against a $7,000 PO that the invoice below also claims. Run both at once: the PO row lock decides which one wins, and it is genuinely either.

13_concurrency_race_keyboard_b.pdf.label: Concurrency race — 2 of 2
13_concurrency_race_keyboard_b.pdf.note: The same $4,000 claim against the same $7,000 PO. Together they want $8,000, so only one can be approved -- whichever transaction reaches the lock first.
